clips.title: The story
paras: Tinkmaster Overspark sends Alliance adventurers into Gnomeregan for Techbot's memory core. The machine once aided researchers, but radiation and an electrical surge during the city's fall left its brain polarized and its behavior violent. Overspark hopes the core will help him reverse the damage and restore his creation.

Before Gnomeregan fell, Techbot aided researchers with its many devices and vast technical knowledge. Tinkmaster Overspark designed the mechanical assistant, whose integrated gizmos made it a marvel of gnomish ingenuity. The trogg invasion brought chaos, and toxic radiation filled the city. A stray electrical surge jolted Techbot's delicate inner workings, polarizing its positronic brain into a volatile negatronic state.

Techbot now wanders Gnomeregan's contaminated halls in a frenzy, attacking anyone in sight. Overspark refuses to abandon his prized assistant as scrap. He asks capable operatives to find the machine, remove its memory core from the metal chassis, and bring it to Ironforge. With the core, the Tinkmaster hopes to understand the polarization and repair Techbot's mind.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: When our beloved city Gnomeregan fell, a rogue spark must have jolted my poor creation, Techbot. It once aided me and my associates with its countless gizmos and limitless store of information, but its positronic brain has polarized. Now it's negatronic... And Techbot's behaviors are reversed. It roams Gnomeregan in a frenzy!
But perhaps it can be salvaged. Perhaps, if you can retrieve Techbot's memory core and bring it to me, I can discover the cause of the polarization and fix my poor Techbot.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Did you find Techbot? Did you retrieve its memory core??

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh, this is wonderful! Thank you, friend! I'll get to work immediately!!
Poor, poor Techbot... Don't feel bad. We'll get you fixed.
Now, where did I put that plug for my hydro-jack swivel spanner...
